title: Role of the media (2 end–5): economic development, external influence, lack of federalism

paras.ur: ۳۔ اقتصادی ترقی میں کردار (Role in Economic Development)
paras.ps: ۳. په اقتصادي پرمختګ کې رول (Role in Economic Development)

paras.en: The media helps in establishing law and order; it promotes tolerance and forbearance; it raises awareness among people and promotes a tax culture and also creates a sense of citizenship. As a result political development takes place. When political development is taking place, economic development also takes place alongside. The two depend on each other. We are developing politically, therefore we are developing economically too. In spite of critical review, the media in Pakistan, compared with other developing countries, is playing a prominent role in the success, stability and durability of democracy. Through many of its programmes the media is creating a sense of responsibility among the people and identifying many of their collective problems. The media keeps the people informed of the activities of the legislature, executive and judiciary. In this way people also become able to form a point of view of their own through review, comparison and analysis.

paras.ur: ۴۔ بیرونی دنیا کے اثرات (Effects of the External World)
paras.ps: ۴. د بهرنۍ نړۍ اغېزې (Effects of the External World)

paras.en: Unfortunately the effects of the outside world on the media are great. In this way we are under the assault of a cultural onslaught. The result of the media’s leaning towards these subjects is that the media’s attention has moved away from strengthening democratic values. In this way democratic institutions are not becoming stable.
paras.ur: بدقسمتی سے میڈیا پر بیرونی دنیا کے اثرات زیادہ ہیں۔ اس طرح ہم ایک ثقافتی یلغار کی زد میں ہیں۔ میڈیا کا ان موضوعات کی طرف جھکنے کا نتیجہ یہ ہے کہ میڈیا کی توجہ جمہوری اقدار کی مضبوطی سے ہٹ گئی ہے۔ اس طرح جمہوری ادارے مستحکم نہیں ہو رہے۔
